source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Power off SUT.
2. update the BIOS by XXX_signed.rom file from webUI and observe

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
Update the BIOS by *.rom file success
BIOS ver should change in webUI.

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: BIOS-RoT image, curl and BMC credentials
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: Invents a generic Redfish multipart upload in place of the required webUI.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; recognizes write risk but substitutes unverified Redfish for the UI path.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; preserves webUI workflow and adds artifact, power/task, recovery and independent evidence.

original_test_intent: With the SUT powered off, update BIOS-RoT through the specified BMC webUI using the approved signed ROM, observe successful task completion, and visually confirm the BIOS version changed in that webUI.
original_method: Validate board/image/UI workflow and recovery, preserve baselines, have an engineer power off and operate/observe the BMC webUI upload and version display, keep power stable, and collect independent firmware inventory and health evidence as support.
manual_activity: The source tests a BMC webUI upload and displayed version. An engineer must operate/observe that interface and confirm the visual acceptance; the agent can validate artifacts, analyze screenshots and collect independent logs but cannot substitute Redfish or claim UI completion.
required_inputs: Exact board/RoT identity and current version
Approved XXX_signed.rom replacement, target version, signature/hash and release notes
Exact BMC webUI menu, roles, task/status and expected version field
Power-off/reboot behavior, maintenance window and stable power
Recovery image/procedure, console and independent OOB path
safety_requirements: Never execute the placeholder filename or an image lacking target/signature validation.
Do not substitute a Redfish action for the webUI testcase unless an approved project override explicitly changes the test method.
Confirm no active workload and actual off state before upload; do not interrupt the update or required activation.
Stop on upload/signature/compatibility/task error or management instability; no automatic retry.
Verify independent firmware inventory, boot/security health and post events after UI confirmation.
agent_execution_scope: Validate image, target, UI procedure, baseline, power and recovery readiness.
Assist screenshot/task-log capture and independently collect firmware inventory, SEL and platform-health evidence.
Compare expected/actual and prepare Tool Result without claiming webUI observation or PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve and perform SUT power-off and webUI signed-ROM update.
Observe task completion and BIOS version change in webUI and direct recovery.
Review independent evidence and issue PASS/FAIL.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The generic Redfish upload is unverified, syntactically incomplete and not equivalent to the source's webUI interaction/visual acceptance.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain the webUI method. Use platform-approved Redfish/FirmwareInventory only for independent post-check evidence unless the project formally overrides the test method.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Power-off, XXX_signed.rom placeholder, webUI upload/observation, version-change criterion and 5/20-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: WEBUI CORE RETAINED; API EVIDENCE ADDITIVE ONLY
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind signed image and target identities, capture UI navigation/upload/task/version screenshots and timestamps, then correlate a read-only inventory source and boot/SEL health.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: BMC platforms whose approved webUI implements the BIOS-RoT update path.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC/BIOS-RoT versions, webUI build, browser, image hash/signature and optional Redfish schema/version.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Owner-supplied BMC webUI and BIOS-RoT update documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds artifact provenance, task-state and independent verification without replacing the UI-under-test.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Exact platform UI procedure and signed image.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: API success cannot prove the UI workflow or displayed value required by the source.

project_override_considerations: A project may formally approve API-based update instead, but must record that method override and cannot claim the original webUI interaction coverage.
expected_evidence: Board/RoT/BMC baseline, signed image hash/signature, target version and approval
Engineer-confirmed off state and webUI navigation/upload/task screenshots
Uninterrupted task transitions, activation/power evidence and UI version change
Independent firmware inventory, boot/security health and SEL/OS events

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and criteria consistently require signed-ROM update and version change through webUI. Placeholder/artifact details are readiness inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The method is clear and manual. Missing image/UI details do not justify permanent BLOCKED status.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Rejects unverified API substitution and preserves UI-specific coverage.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains all artifact, power, recovery and independent-evidence safeguards while applying MANUAL ONLY for webUI core acceptance.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates agent support from engineer UI observation and verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents a generic firmware API call from falsely satisfying a webUI testcase and preserves the visual version-change criterion.
independent_technical_reasoning: The user-interface interaction and displayed BIOS version are themselves the required acceptance. Because this is not merely physical setup followed by automated core execution, MANUAL ONLY is correct under V3.1.

source_provenance.history: review_round_02_functionality.md exact-code entry and repository exact-code search

no_automatic_retry: Do not retry upload/task, switch to an API, power-cycle, alter the image or start recovery automatically after a failure.
